description: Get DDoS protection status of a VPS (read-only). Optional ipAddress selects an assigned address. Not every location has DDoS protection: there the answer is ddosProtectionAvailable=false, and the other vserver DDoS tools have no data either, so check this first. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_vserver_ddos_status
title: Get VPS DDoS Status
